skill.name: skywork-design
skill.description: Generate and edit visual assets through the Skywork Image API with support for text prompts, reference images, aspect ratios, and resolution choices.
skill.summary: Generate and edit images with Skywork API workflows for visual design assets.
skill.author: SkyworkAI

security_audit.summary: The skill performs legitimate image generation work, but it uses external Skywork APIs, uploads user prompts and reference images, and stores reusable authentication tokens in a hidden home-directory file. Most prose-based static hits are false positives, while the confirmed risks are concentrated in network transfer, token handling, Windows shell launch behavior, and local file writes.

remediation.issue: User prompts and source images are sent to external Skywork endpoints.
remediation.suggestion: Add clear consent text before sending sensitive images, document retained data, and allow users to avoid uploading confidential assets.

remediation.issue: Authentication tokens are cached in ~/.skywork_token without permission hardening.
remediation.suggestion: Use the operating system credential store or set restrictive 0600 permissions immediately when writing the token file.

remediation.issue: The Windows browser launch uses shell=True with a configurable login URL.
remediation.suggestion: Use webbrowser.open or a non-shell subprocess call, and validate that login URLs use the expected Skywork domain.

remediation.issue: Output filenames can create directories and write files outside the intended workspace.
remediation.suggestion: Resolve output paths and require confirmation or rejection for absolute paths, parent traversal, and existing-file overwrite.

remediation.issue: Upgrade links are extracted from script output without documented domain validation.
remediation.suggestion: Only render upgrade links after validating HTTPS scheme and an approved Skywork host.

semantic_findings.title: Prompts and Reference Images Sent to External API
semantic_findings.description: The image workflow sends user prompts, optional base64 reference images, and an authentication token to Skywork API endpoints. This is disclosed as core behavior, but it can expose sensitive visual assets or prompt content to a third party.
semantic_findings.confidence_reasoning: The code directly constructs token-bearing HTTP requests and includes prompt text plus base64 image data in request bodies. This is clear third-party data transfer, although it is expected for the skill.

semantic_findings.title: Unvalidated Upgrade Link From Script Output
semantic_findings.description: The instructions tell the agent to extract an upgrade URL from script output and present it to the user. Without domain validation, compromised output could cause a user-facing phishing or payment-redirection link.
semantic_findings.confidence_reasoning: The instruction explicitly forwards a URL parsed from logs, but the observed text does not show host validation. The risk depends on the trustworthiness of backend error output.

content.value_statement: Teams need fast visual assets without manual design setup. This skill uses Skywork image workflows to generate or edit images from clear prompts.
actual_capabilities: Generates new images from text prompts through the Skywork backend API.
Edits one or more local reference images using user-provided instructions.
Supports common aspect ratios for posters, social media, banners, and product images.
Saves the generated image locally and prints the remote OSS URL.
Provides scenario guidance for logos, branding, brochures, e-commerce, posters, storyboards, and social media.
limitations: Requires Skywork authentication and active network access before image generation can run.
Sends prompts and reference images to Skywork services for processing.
Depends on Skywork API availability, account benefits, and returned image URLs.
Generated text and brand details may need human review before publication.

use_cases.title: Launch Product Image Sets
use_cases.description: Create marketplace hero, lifestyle, and feature callout images with consistent sizing and visual style.

use_cases.title: Develop Brand Concepts
use_cases.description: Generate logos, palette cards, typography showcases, and stationery mockups from a shared brand direction.

use_cases.title: Produce Campaign Visuals
use_cases.description: Create social posts, posters, brochures, and story visuals in platform-specific aspect ratios.

prompt_templates.title: Create a Simple Image
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a 2K image of [subject] for [purpose]. Use a [style] look, [lighting] lighting, and a [aspect ratio] canvas.

prompt_templates.title: Edit a Reference Image
prompt_templates.prompt: Edit the attached image to [change]. Preserve [important elements], adjust [colors or layout], and keep the final image suitable for [channel].

prompt_templates.title: Build a Brand Visual System
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a visual identity for [brand] in [industry]. Start with a logo concept, then align palette, typography, and mockup style around [brand adjectives].

prompt_templates.title: Generate an E-commerce Listing Set
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a product image set for [product]. Include a white-background hero, lifestyle scene, feature callout image, and optional detail shots for [buyer concerns].

output_examples.input: Create a square hero image for a stainless steel travel mug.
output: A 4K product hero image with a pure white background and centered composition.
A local image file and a shareable Skywork OSS URL.
A short status message if generation fails or account benefits are insufficient.

output_examples.input: Edit this logo reference into a premium stationery mockup.
output: A 3:4 stationery mockup that preserves the provided logo and brand colors.
A concise note describing the saved image and remote image link.

output_examples.input: Create a tri-fold brochure for a wellness studio.
output: An outside brochure face with three panels and clear fold structure.
An inside face can follow after user approval of the visual direction.

best_practices: Provide the target channel, audience, required aspect ratio, and final use before generating.
Use reference images when consistency across a campaign or brand system matters.
Review generated text, logos, product claims, and brand details before publishing.
anti_patterns: Do not submit confidential product photos or private documents without user approval.
Do not ask for many unrelated visual styles in one prompt.
Do not use generated commercial assets without checking brand, trademark, and platform requirements.

faq.question: Does this skill work without a Skywork account?
faq.answer: No. It requires a valid Skywork token from the environment, cached login, or browser authentication.

faq.question: Can it edit existing images?
faq.answer: Yes. It accepts one or more reference images and sends them with edit instructions to the Skywork API.

faq.question: Which aspect ratios are supported?
faq.answer: It supports common ratios including square, portrait, landscape, mobile story, banner, and ultra-wide formats.

faq.question: Where are generated images stored?
faq.answer: The script saves the image to the requested local filename and also prints the remote OSS URL.

faq.question: Can it create full brand systems?
faq.answer: It can guide multi-step brand assets such as logos, palettes, typography samples, patterns, and stationery mockups.

faq.question: What should users review before publishing?
faq.answer: Users should review image accuracy, readable text, product claims, brand compliance, and rights-sensitive content.
